_note: Glossary for the Guide screen and tap tooltips. keys = lowercase text that points at the entry. Boon families and legendary powers are added from boons.json and items.json at runtime.

entries.short: Average damage of one weapon swing, before armor.
entries.long: A weapon's average damage per swing, halfway between its minimum and maximum (shown in brackets). Abilities, crits and boons add to it.

entries.short: Extra damage added to every hit you make.
entries.long: Flat damage added to each of your weapon hits. Comes from gear and some buffs.

entries.short: Reduces the damage you take from every hit.
entries.long: Armor shaves a share of the damage off every hit you take: the more armor, the bigger the share (up to 30% at very high armor). Shown as a positive number; higher is better.

entries.short: Hit points. At 0 you die.
entries.long: Hit points. At 0 you die, and lose everything you carry. Potions, campfires, shrines and some boons heal you.

entries.short: Fuel for a mage's spells.
entries.long: Mages spend mana on spells; it slowly comes back every turn. Other classes use cooldowns instead.

entries.short: Chance to turn aside melee blows with your weapon.
entries.long: Skill at deflecting melee attacks with your weapon. A successful parry means the blow does no damage.

entries.short: Chance to step out of the way of melee blows.
entries.long: Skill at dodging melee attacks entirely.

entries.short: Chance to catch blows on your shield.
entries.long: Only works if you carry a shield (warriors do). A block stops the blow.

entries.short: Chance of a second swing each melee turn.
entries.long: Each melee turn, a chance to swing a second time. Higher is more often.

entries.short: Chance of a third swing each melee turn.
entries.long: Each melee turn, a chance to swing a third time (after the second).

entries.short: Chance for a hit to deal bonus damage.
entries.long: Each hit has this % chance to deal extra damage.

entries.short: A critical hit: +75% damage.
entries.long: A critical hit deals +75% damage. Some classes and boons crit; the Storm family makes crits stronger.

entries.short: Boon effects that cut the damage you take, capped at 90%.
entries.long: Percent damage reduction from boons and families adds up, but is capped at 90% in total, so you can never become unkillable. Flat reductions (like Iron Skin) still apply after the cap, but every hit does at least 1 damage.

entries.short: +15% weapon damage.
entries.long: A sharp weapon deals 15% more damage.

entries.short: +5% weapon damage.
entries.long: A vorpal weapon deals 5% more damage.

entries.short: Each hit adds a burst of fire damage.
entries.long: Every hit that lands also burns the target for extra fire damage.

entries.short: Each hit adds a bite of cold damage.
entries.long: Every hit that lands also chills the target for extra cold damage.

entries.short: Hits can poison the target.
entries.long: Hits can poison the target, dealing damage every turn for 3 turns (unless it resists).

entries.short: Hits drain extra life and heal you.
entries.long: Every hit drains a little extra life and heals you for half of it.

entries.short: The star line on a legendary item.
entries.long: Legendary items carry a special power (the line marked with a star). Bulk sell never sells legendaries.

entries.short: How deep an item comes from; higher rolls bigger numbers.
entries.long: Item level (ilvl) grows with the floor you find it on. Higher item levels roll bigger stats.

entries.short: Common, uncommon, rare, epic, legendary.
entries.long: Rarer items have bigger numbers and more extra properties: common (grey), uncommon (green), rare (blue), epic (purple), legendary (orange, with a special power).

entries.short: Better than what you wear in every way.
entries.long: The green upgrade arrow marks an item that beats what you have equipped in every stat and loses nothing. Items that are better in one way but worse in another don't get it.

entries.short: Can't defend well and loses its next action.
entries.long: A knocked-down target is easier to hit and loses its next turn getting up.

entries.short: Misses far more often.
entries.long: A blind fighter misses most of its attacks until it can see again.

entries.short: Loses its turns.
entries.long: A stunned fighter can't act until it recovers.

entries.short: Frozen solid for a turn: can't act.
entries.long: Frozen works like a short stun. The Frost family makes it last longer and hit harder.

entries.short: Acts less often.
entries.long: A slowed fighter gets fewer turns.

entries.short: Acts more often.
entries.long: A hasted fighter gets extra turns.

entries.short: Out cold until hit.
entries.long: A sleeping fighter does nothing until it takes damage.

entries.short: Takes damage every turn.
entries.long: Poison deals damage every turn for a few turns.

entries.short: Takes damage every turn.
entries.long: Bleeding deals damage every turn for a few turns.

entries.short: Takes half damage.
entries.long: A holy ward that halves all damage taken.

entries.short: Hits harder, heals a little.
entries.long: A rage that raises accuracy and damage.

entries.short: Leave the Spiral with everything you carry.
entries.long: Press Extract and your character walks back to the floor's entrance. There you can attempt the extraction: 80% of the time you're ambushed and must clear one short stretch first. Make it out and you keep your gold and every item you carry.

entries.short: A short floor you must clear to finish extracting.
entries.long: Three small rooms with a few awake enemies. Clear them all and you're out. Only ever one ambush per extraction.

entries.short: Lose everything you carry.
entries.long: Dying loses your gold and every item you carry, including gear you brought in. (Your account's very first death is a one-time rescue.)

entries.short: A tougher monster with an orange ring. Kill it for a boon.
entries.long: Elites hit harder and have more HP; killing one always gives a boon pick and good loot.

entries.short: The floor-6 guardian. The stairs stay sealed until it dies.
entries.long: The boss waits on the last floor. The way out is sealed until it's dead.

entries.short: Walk over it for a free blessing.
entries.long: Shrines grant a random blessing: healing, a potion, gold, a rare item or XP.

entries.short: Walk over it to recover 40% HP and mana.
entries.long: Each campfire can be used once.

entries.short: Heals 50% of your max HP. You drink them.
entries.long: You start each run with 3 healing potions (mages also get mana potions). Monsters drop more now and then.

entries.short: A power that lasts the rest of the run.
entries.long: Pick one of three on every level-up and elite kill. Stackable boons can be taken again and again; each copy adds its effect.

entries.short: Limited ways to change a boon offer.
entries.long: Skip takes nothing; Reroll replaces all three offers; Banish removes one boon from the pool for the run. Buy more per run at the Trainer.

entries.short: Storage shared by all your characters.
entries.long: Everything you bring home lands in the stash (up to 500 items). Equip characters from it or sell in bulk.

entries.short: Power-ups bought with gold.
entries.long: Permanent power-ups for every character: more HP, more damage, extra potions and Skip/Reroll/Banish charges.

entries.short: Buys gear for your stash.
entries.long: New stock after every run, sized to the deepest floor you've reached.

entries.short: Grows with every run of a class; unlocks its skills.
entries.long: Each class has a mastery level (1 to 10) shared by all your characters of that class. Every run adds its XP, however it ends. Mastery decides which skills the class knows and how well it uses passive skills like parry and dodge. Levels inside a run only raise HP and damage.
